meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 插件启用后自动注入项目规则：SessionStart 与 UserPromptSubmit 时注入静态项目指令，apply_patch 之后默认注入匹配的文件专属规则；动态 PostToolUse 输出作为附加上下文注入并按会话去重，不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当你问到 Codex Rules 的行为、支持的规则文件位置或环境配置时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 都从哪些文件读规则？
say.note: 会列出支持的项目规则来源。

say.text: 怎么把 Codex Rules 临时关掉？
say.note: 会给出对应的环境变量设置。

say.text: 为什么我的规则没被注入？
say.note: 会说明匹配与注入的时机。

howto.what_en: Codex Rules injects project rules: static instructions on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and file-specific rules after apply_patch. Dynamic PostToolUse output is added as context, deduplicated per session; tool output is not rewritten.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about Codex Rules behavior, supported rule file locations, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: Which files does Codex Rules read rules from?
say_en.note: Lists the supported project rule sources.

say_en.text: How do I turn Codex Rules off temporarily?
say_en.note: Shows the environment variable to set.
